clips.title: The story
paras: In Ambermill, Dalaran wizards are weaving magic that threatens the Forsaken's hold on Silverpine Forest. Shadow Priest Allister sends agents from the Sepulcher to disrupt their spellwork and seize the magical foci.

Ambermill is a human town in the hills of eastern Silverpine Forest, held by wizards and defenders pledged to the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. The mages are weaving magical energies in a vast ritual. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister and his companion Dalar recognize the danger. If the Kirin Tor channel their power unchecked, the Forsaken risk being driven from Silverpine entirely.

While Dalar scries the forest and traces the flow of magic, Allister sends agents to strike the practitioners in Ambermill. Dalaran conjurers, mages, and their protectors wear enchanted pendants that focus and coordinate their arts. Taking the talismans from slain sorcerers disrupts the ritual and gives the Sepulcher time to find the ringleader directing the arcane weave.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...
The conjurers, adventurers and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.
Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We must hurry, their plans must not come to fruition, or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.
A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.
